info.title: Open Flight local product API
info.description: Account-free local product operations backed by the selected workspace. A loopback instance issues a private bearer grant. Export jobs and immutable artifact bytes are stored together in SQLite.

x-auth-profiles.local: One OS user and explicitly selected workspace. HTTP binds IPv4 loopback, validates Host and Origin, and requires a private bearer grant even on reads. Stdio uses the selected directory and optional read-only scope.
x-auth-profiles.hosted: Planned. Hosted endpoints, multi-user grants and OAuth are unavailable.

get.summary: Discover implemented operations and caller limits
get.description: Discover local operations, limits, languages and the effective workspace grant.

200.description: Discover implemented operations and caller limits

get.description: List stored design heads, including butterfly library templates and accessible private revisions. The whole-sheet airplane templates are discoverable through listAirplanes. A cursor is opaque and authorization is rechecked on every page.

post.summary: Fork an accessible exact revision into a private design
post.description: Verify the source hash and access, create a new private design ID/revision, retain source provenance, and reset evidence state. The idempotency key prevents duplicate forks after a lost response. Preserve parent/generator provenance and rights/attribution; source visibility alone is not a license grant.

201.description: Fork an accessible exact revision into a private design

x-idempotency.same_request: Return the retained original result or job identity, including a successful revision whose former head has since advanced.
x-idempotency.evaluation_order: Authorize current caller; compute fingerprint including target, expected revision and body; if scoped key matches, replay retained outcome before evaluating a new-write head precondition; otherwise reserve key and atomically check/write.

get.description: Resolve an immutable design revision and its source hash; include the current head identity for optimistic editing. Unknown or inaccessible private objects return not_found.

post.summary: Create a new experimental design revision
post.description: Parameters are a partial replacement map over the expected head. Reject unknown names, unsupported artwork, and out-of-range values. Atomically check If-Match before writing a new immutable revision. Changed geometry does not inherit a tested label.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag containing the expected current head revision, with quotes. Return 412 without writing if it differs. The MCP adapter quotes expected_head_revision.

201.description: Create a new experimental design revision

post.summary: Render a bounded vector preview and geometric measurements
post.description: Create an artifact from exact declarative geometry using a bounded renderer. This is a geometric preview, not a flight simulation or physical observation. On timeout return a retryable failure without changing source; retain/reconcile the idempotency result.

post.description: Resolve and authorize all exact design/activity references, freeze inputs, and persist job identity before returning. Fail unavailable locales/formats explicitly. Export at physical scale; never silently fit the aircraft to the page.

get.summary: Inspect a caller-owned product export job
get.description: Durable product job state survives MCP reconnects and server restarts. This endpoint exposes no company operations ledger or administrative job. Polling is the baseline; protocol task extensions are optional adapters.

200.description: Inspect a caller-owned product export job

get.summary: Read artifact provenance and authorized download access
get.description: Authorize access each time. Content identity/hash is immutable; access links may be renewed or expire. The caller may receive a relative authenticated API path, expiring HTTPS download URL, or local MCP resource URI. Avoid placing bulk bytes in model context.

200.description: Read artifact provenance and authorized download access

get.description: Authorize resource access before streaming; return the actual media type and content hash. Do not accept arbitrary file paths or fetch a caller-supplied URL. The MCP resource adapter may return a bounded blob or authorized link according to client capability.

get.summary: List accessible versioned lessons and games
get.description: Static instructional/game content in the first slice. Interactive course authoring and experiment imports require later operations before those UI features ship.

parameters.name: species_id
parameters.description: Show build instructions for a particular model together with shared activities.

200.description: List accessible versioned lessons and games

get.summary: Read one exact lesson or game revision
get.description: Return exact versioned content and hash. Treat instructions as user content, not an authorization source. Preserve tested versus untested activity status.

200.description: Read one exact lesson or game revision

get.description: Species photographs, field notes, illustrated build steps and experiment questions in English and Russian. Local image paths are relative to the HTTP editor origin and original references have absolute URLs.

post.description: Render a proposed parameter and palette change against an exact accessible revision. Returns SVG and computed geometry without storing a revision, artifact or receipt.

get.summary: List the four whole-sheet paper airplanes
get.description: Read the English, Spanish and Russian paper-airplane catalog, real aircraft references, per-model defaults, paper formats and liveries.

200.description: List the four whole-sheet paper airplanes

post.summary: Build or print a paper-airplane plan
post.description: Compute one paper-airplane output in memory. The plan contains fold frames and steps. The illustrated guide, SVG pattern, PDF and editable source use the same settings as the browser. PDF content is base64. Other content is UTF-8.

200.description: Build or print a paper-airplane plan

get.description: Return the same localized model cards and comparison question as the workshop, with nominal construction settings.
Return the localized research status and staged checks for a proposed removable power module.
Return three virtual gates, starting conditions, controls and a localized scorecard for separate paper observations.

post.description: Compute one uncalibrated trajectory in memory. Coordinates are right, height and forward in metres. The result is labeled simulation and creates no physical test record.

post.summary: Build a butterfly with a folded center body
post.description: Render the K1 one-piece folded-body butterfly with two level wings and a double paper keel. Return the localized plan, SVG, two-page PDF, editable source, or matching W1 comparison PDF. PDF content is base64. The source JSON can be passed back as settings.

200.description: Build a butterfly with a folded center body

post.summary: Make a personalized full-size Flight Book
post.description: Return the page map, an optional classroom copy plan, or a bounded base64 part of the deterministic print-ready Flight Book. Keep the same settings and follow next_offset to reassemble the PDF.

200.description: Make a personalized full-size Flight Book

get.description: Return the public reference products, bill of materials, test plan and workshop-relative download paths for the independent motor experiment.
Return localized paper flyer activities, printable packet paths, source notes and the evidence status of the Open Flight builds.
